summary: Clean on the SEC dimension. The module reads a raw sqlite3* out of a Python sqlite3.Connection and is gated by a strict isinstance type check, a version-coordination guard (libraries_coordinated), a null check, and a runtime validation call. The only inputs are a trusted sqlite3.Connection object and a sqlite version string that both originate from CPython's own stdlib, not from untrusted/attacker-controlled data, so there is no reachable bounds/format/SQL/path injection surface. No SEC findings.
